photo.alt: French Guiana seen from the International Space Station
photo.credit: Earth Science and Remote Sensing Unit, Lyndon B. Johnson Space Center, Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons

facts: Borders Suriname to the west and Brazil to the east and south
worth_knowing: About 98.9% of it is forest, much of it primeval rainforest. The Guiana Space Centre is the European Space Agency's main launch site, near the equator.
